verdicts.reason: A keeps a strong left-hand headline and sensible left-to-right flow, but the RSVP CTA has shrunk to a pill the same size as the badges, the broken 'missing asset' box sits in the middle of the canvas, 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' runs right up against 'Saturday 21 June', and the URL and legal text are tiny. B's reading order is broken: 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has dropped to the bottom of the text stack, the RSVP CTA is jammed into the top-right corner with the badges, and the text lines are packed into a tight right-hand column while the lower half sits empty; its only strength is the large product can.
